name: Trigger payload carries file metadata not content
symptom: Trigger input shows file properties only (observe and record; exact fields UNVERIFIED). Without a reader tool the agent cannot see Report ID, Asset ID or Severity and may invent values. A report with a blank Asset ID can produce a work order on a guessed asset.
cause: A SharePoint file-created trigger notifies that a file exists; content must be fetched by a tool. Event triggers run only under generative orchestration, so tool choice depends on instructions and descriptions. Missing asset ID is a data quality gap in the report.
fix: Treat the payload as an address: pass the file identifier, call a reader tool first that returns named fields, validate required fields before any write, send blank Asset ID to a human. Alternative: capture fields as library columns at upload.

name: Run-as identity is the maker
symptom: A file dropped by Sofia Brennan (no access to HLE-Dev) creates a work order whose Created By and Owner are the learner. Only the file's Created By shows the dropper.
cause: Event triggers run only with the agent author's credentials; all tool connections are the maker's.
fix: Restrict write access to the watched folder; run production agents under a dedicated least-privilege service account; record the dropper from the payload in the work order; heed the publish warning.

name: Autonomous runs consume Copilot Credits
symptom: PPAC Copilot Studio consumption report shows billed credits for HLE Field Report Triage although all personas are Copilot licensed; several agent actions per run (observe and record credits per run).
cause: Autonomous runs are billable even for licensed users; zero-rating applies to licensed users chatting in Microsoft 365 channels. Each tool call is an agent action.
fix: Estimate runs x actions x current rates before deploying; stop early with file filter and idempotency check; allocate capacity and review the environment and agent reports.

name: Self-triggering loop
symptom: Agent writes its summary into the watched folder; each summary starts a new run; duplicate or junk work orders, repeated emails, rising credits (observe and record; no platform loop limit documented).
cause: Output written inside the trigger scope, library-wide trigger, no file filter and no idempotency key. Design error, not a platform limit.
fix: Write output to a different folder (Triaged), scope or filter the trigger to Procedures/Incoming, use WO-<Report ID> as an idempotency key checked before create, and name outputs so they cannot match the input pattern.
